answer.evidence: The lathe bed shows a clear 6-pixel-deep horizontal top surface (rows 10-15) with the carriage and bed ways foreshortened, above a 5-pixel front face (rows 16-20). The headstock and tailstock also show 3-4 pixel top surfaces.

The lathe bed shows a clear 5-pixel-deep horizontal top way/bed surface (rows 11-15) above its front vertical face (rows 16-20). The headstock and tailstock also show distinct foreshortened top surfaces (3-4 rows) with an angled elliptical feature at the top left.

The lathe bed shows a clear 3/4 top-down horizontal surface (grey guideways/bed) spanning rows 9-15 (approx. 7 source pixel rows), with its front face below it at rows 16-20. The headstock and tailstock blocks also clearly show foreshortened top surfaces in lighter blue.

The main bed ways (rows 10-16) form a clearly visible horizontal top surface 7 pixels tall, flanked by the headstock and tailstock which also show distinct top surfaces (rows 4-7 and rows 6-8). The front face of the bed is visible beneath it (rows 17-21) on top of the base legs.
